description: Search and discover Swedish companies without knowing their organisation number. Filter by company name (partial match), industry code, or presence of active distress signals. Returns compact summary cards — each card includes the organisation_number needed to call get_company for full intelligence. All parameters are optional; omit all to browse all companies in the dataset. Discovery flow: (1) call search_companies to find a company, (2) use the returned organisation_number to call get_company for full intelligence.

has_signals.description: If true, return only companies with active distress signals. If false, return only companies without. Omit to return all.

industry_code.description: Swedish SNI numeric prefix (2–5 digits), matching any registered activity; e.g. '62' for IT

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return (default 20, max 100)

locality.description: Registered locality, combined with ANY matching SNI

name.description: Partial company name to search (case-insensitive substring match on legal name)

name: search_companies
